title: Israel Discount Bank to Let Customers Trade Bitcoin in App Starting Nov. 26
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Israel Discount Bank to Let Customers Trade Bitcoin in App Starting Nov. 26 Eligible customers 18 and older can buy, hold and sell bitcoin and ether from Nov. 26, with Fireblocks custody and a six-month fee waiver. This post Israel Discount Bank to Let Customers Trade Bitcoin in App Starting Nov. 26 first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
